```yaml
name: PR CI

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
  push:
    branches: [main]

concurrency:
  group: pr-ci-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Lint
        run: npm run lint

      - name: Type check
        run: npm run typecheck

      - name: Build
        run: npm run build

      - name: Run tests
        run: npm test -- --ci
        env:
          CI: true

      - name: Upload test results to Codecov
        uses: codecov/test-results-action@v1
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.CODECOV_TOKEN }}
          directory: ./test-results

      - name: Upload coverage to Codecov
        uses: codecov/codecov-action@v3
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.CODECOV_TOKEN }}
          files: ./coverage/lcov.info
          flags: unittests
          name: codecov-umbrella

      - name: PostHog CI tracking
        uses: PostHog/posthog-github-action@eea1405eeb2d1d2259f0ee0b44d7b152869e6840
        with:
          posthog-token: ${{ secrets.POSTHOG_TOKEN }}
          event: ci-run
          properties: '{"branch":"${{ github.ref }}","workflow":"${{ github.workflow }}"}'
          capture-run-duration: true
          capture-job-durations: true
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          runner: ${{ runner.name }}
          status-job: ${{ job.status }}

      - name: Autofix formatting and lint issues
        uses: autofix-ci/action@635ffb0c9798bd160680f18fd73371e355b85f27
        with:
          fail-fast: false
          commit-message: "chore: autofix formatting and lint"
          comment: "Autofix applied"
```
